headline: Houthi Forces Renew Threats Against Riyadh Airport as Flights Resume
summary: Yemen's Houthi movement renewed threats against Riyadh's international airport as commercial flights prepared to restart. The statement raises regional security risks across Middle Eastern transport corridors.
why: Regional conflict risks in the Arabian Peninsula can impact commercial aviation, supply chain logistics, and global oil prices.

impacts.name: Middle East Aviation
impacts.why: Security threats to major international airports create operational disruptions and elevated security costs.
